component.name: FastApiClient
component.summary: Light and fast REST API client

description.p: FastApiClient is a light and fast REST API client for Linux. It starts quickly, uses little memory and keeps your requests in plain files.

ul.li: Projects with nested folders; headers and auth are inherited down to each request
Environments and variables, with autocomplete after {{
Chain requests: take a token from another request's response and reuse it
Response panel with JSON and XML beautify, search, headers and the request actually sent
Import Insomnia v5 exports; export projects as JSON

description.p: Projects, folders, environments, variables, response chaining and Insomnia v5 import.
Add active request progress and cancellation support
